observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha-branded electronic keyboard with purple control panel and a row of black/white keys; no model number visible.
Photo 1 shows the front with large “YAMAHA” text; two orange/black speaker grilles/side cutouts are visible; no screen/model label readable.
Photo 2 shows the keyboard from a closer angle; still no readable model name/number or ports/accessories shown.

claims.evidence: Photos show a Yamaha keyboard, but the model/spec (e.g., PSR/E/DGX) and whether it’s “professional” are not readable.
Photos clearly show “YAMAHA” on the keyboard body (photo 1), not Casio.

risks.risk: Model/spec is not readable, so the exact value tier (PSR E413/E453 vs higher models) is unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the model label/sticker (usually on the back/bottom) and the full front panel including any model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic/unknown Yamaha portable keyboard (worst-case within the comparable range).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (keys, speakers, volume, power, demo/sound, sustain/pitch bend).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on + play several keys + show volume change + (if present) pitch bend/mod wheel + record output or headphone test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/assume basic operation only (worst-case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/adapter not shown (power supply is critical for keyboards).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the charger/adapter (label with voltage/amp) and what’s included in the box.
risks.if_unproven: Price as keyboard only (worst-case for buyer needing to source adapter).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: damaged keys, stuck buttons, dead speaker, or cosmetic wear.
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of the keybed (all keys), control buttons/knobs, and speaker area; plus a video showing sound from both sides if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition (worst-case vs “clean/working perfectly”).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model label/sticker (back or bottom) showing exact Yamaha model number/name.
Video of power-on and sound test (play keys across low/mid/high, show volume working).
Photo of included power adapter/charger (or confirm it’s included).
Close-up photos of all controls/ports and speaker area; confirm no missing knobs/buttons.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model and working condition (and whether accessories like the adapter are included) are not verifiable from the images, so a safe price cannot be selected.
